arguments.name: Animation Timeline Contract
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the timeline step: the compiled timeline's beats cover the duration without gaps, every transition names a window inside both beats, every hold sits in the measured band.
arguments.subject: animation-timeline-contract
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-timeline.py v3/timeline.json` in the renderer root and passes only when every check it prints passes; its first printed line is its positive control and it refuses to report if the control does not trip. Checks: beats contiguous and summing to the duration; crossing windows inside both beats; worlds named in the world registry; holds 11–27 frames unless marked intentional. On FAIL quote the probe's own line naming the frame or beat and fix the contract or the render, never the probe. Control: a planted 0-frame beat is refused.
